name: mujoco_hopper_v0_wall_clock
description: Hopper-v5 benchmark with a fixed wall-clock training window for single-environment SAC candidates.
notes: Use this benchmark for single-environment fixed-time Hopper recipe comparisons.
Use benchmark_vectorized_wall_clock.json with seed_trainable_vectorized.py when the research question includes vectorization and hardware utilization.
train_episodes is a high safety cap; train_seconds is the intended budget.
